limitations: Only the specified quartic model and characteristic two
Earlier classic full journal articles were not accessible for complete comparison
Other Steiner projections and stable reductions are outside scope
scientific_integrity: Exact intrinsic singular-scheme calculation for the stated quartic in characteristic two. The day-verified archive antecedent is the first public submission of arXiv:0909.2810; an older classical 1996 treatment exists, but its day of first public release is not verified. The normalization and elementary point counts are not themselves asserted as novel. Only self-review was performed.
title: Wild ramification and embedded Jacobian torsion on the characteristic-two Steiner Roman quartic
